description: This Java source file defines the AclEnforcer class, which implements authorization enforcement logic for access control lists within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for checking permissions, constructing JSON views, and mapping permissions between policies and access control lists.

classes.name: AclEnforcer
classes.description: Implements permission enforcement logic for access control lists, allowing checks for permissions, JSON view construction, and permission mapping within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs an AclEnforcer instance with the provided access control list.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the given authorization context has full permissions on a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has at least partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON representation of specified fields if permissions are granted.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs that have the specified permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects that have the specified permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets IDs of subjects with at least partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets subjects with at least partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: mapPermissions
methods.description: Maps policy permissions to ACL permissions of the same name.
